ebc19b8e61.q: What percentage of manufacturing managers enter their role without formal leadership training?
ebc19b8e61.a: 82% of managers step into the role with no formal leadership training at all. This statistic is significant because it means the variable that decides whether a plant absorbs pressure well or poorly is usually the one left most to chance—the leader's own preparation and capability to handle pressure and lead effectively.

81ef535fed.q: What is the pressure paradox in manufacturing leadership and how does it manifest in high performers?
81ef535fed.a: The pressure paradox describes how high performers in manufacturing can swing between two opposite behaviors: overdrive and avoidance. A person thriving on fast-paced, high-pressure environments eventually reaches a point where that chaos becomes unbearable, causing the nervous system to crave stability and predictability. Over time, without addressing this, the same person may paradoxically avoid challenges they once thrived on, or swing back into unsustainable overdrive—a cycle that often leads to burnout if unmanaged.
